title: Privacy-Preserving Dataset Curation for Kuala Lumpur Urban Traffic: Grounded Vision-Language Detection with Spatial Vehicle-Context Filtering
abstract: arXiv:2608.14724v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid advancement of intelligent transportation systems and autonomous driving relies heavily on multi-modal urban traffic datasets. However, curating high-fidelity video imagery in complex tropical urban environments---specifically Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia---presents severe challenges for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) anonymization due to high motorcycle density, dark acrylic license plates, dynamic camera tilt, and extreme tropical glare. We propose an automated anonymization framework tailored for the Kuala Lumpur Road Dataset, captured via a mobile cycling platform at 2 FPS. We document how legacy Haar cascades and YOLOv8 fail under these conditions---generating false positives on background elements while missing rotated or occluded targets. Our architecture resolves this by integrating Grounding DINO---a zero-shot open-set vision-language transformer---with a novel Spatial Vehicle Region of Interest (ROI) Containmen

translated_title: 面向吉隆坡城市交通的隐私保护数据集策展：基于空间车辆上下文过滤的视觉-语言检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14724v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：智能交通系统和自动驾驶的快速发展高度依赖多模态城市交通数据集。然而，在复杂的热带城市环境（特别是马来西亚吉隆坡）中策展高保真视频图像，由于高摩托车密度、深色亚克力车牌、动态摄像头倾斜和极端热带眩光，对个人身份信息（PII）匿名化提出了严峻挑战。我们提出了一种针对吉隆坡道路数据集量身定制的自动化匿名化框架，该数据集通过移动骑行平台以每秒2帧的速度捕获。我们记录了传统Haar级联和YOLOv8在这些条件下失败的情况——在背景元素上产生误报，同时漏检旋转或遮挡的目标。我们的架构通过集成Grounding DINO（一种零样本开放集视觉-语言变换器）和一种新颖的空间车辆感兴趣区域（ROI）包含过滤机制解决了这一问题。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合Grounding DINO和空间车辆上下文过滤的自动化匿名化框架，专门解决吉隆坡热带城市交通数据集中高密度摩托车和极端光照条件下的隐私保护难题，克服了传统检测方法的误报和漏检问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an automated anonymization framework integrating Grounding DINO with spatial vehicle context filtering to address privacy protection challenges in Kuala Lumpur's tropical urban traffic datasets, overcoming false positives and missed detections of traditional methods under high motorcycle density and extreme glare conditions.
